tldr: For one response and exactly two active factors, a public shared-plus-idiosyncratic Gaussian effect prior constrains the six response energies through four signed doses. The sharp information limit is \(\log6-\frac23\log2\), with exactly \(36\) attaining cancellation arrays. The optimized frontier approaches that value from below by \(K_{\mathrm{corr}}(1/s+2\delta)^{1/6}[\log(1/(1/s+2\delta))]^{3/2}\), with an explicit smaller uniform remainder, an attaining dose, and necessary and sufficient dose localization. This is a one-run correlated-slab continuous-dose extension of the DABS activity-information objective. It retains the original public prior and one-response experiment. Terminating certificates cover the whole ratio compactification, realizable optimum approximations, finite-signal values, and the proved correction coefficient and threshold.
gap: Bayesian activity screening supplies the design criterion, and noncoherent communication supplies scale-channel methods. Neither the inspected support-screening result nor the freely chosen energy-alphabet formulas determine the stable optimum of the six coupled signed pair energies.
